subject.title: fix(google-meet): force English UI when reusing existing Chrome tabs

question: Should Google Meet automatic reuse and recovery reload an existing localized tab in place to add `hl=en`, or preserve that tab and select or open a separate English-pinned tab?
rationale: The current patch chooses in-place reload without evidence for already active or user-owned tabs, while the competing filter-first approach changes tab-reuse behavior; repository history does not establish which tradeoff is intended.

options.title: Preserve existing tabs
options.body: Recommended: skip localized tabs during automatic reuse, open or select an English-pinned tab, and make explicit recovery report an actionable state rather than silently reloading an active tab.

options.title: Reload in place
options.body: Allow in-place English navigation only after completing local and node recovery handling and proving with a live localized setup that active-call and target-adoption behavior remain safe.

recommendation.title: Preserve existing tabs
recommendation.body: Recommended: skip localized tabs during automatic reuse, open or select an English-pinned tab, and make explicit recovery report an actionable state rather than silently reloading an active tab.

likelyOwner.reason: This person introduced the current recovery and session-health behavior whose ownership semantics determine whether in-place navigation is safe.
